verdicts.claim: EU AI Act Article 50 duties are judged low relevance for a game that uses AI-made art; counsel is to confirm in one line.
verdicts.what_is_true: The record matches the primary text: 50(2) binds providers of generative systems, 50(4) binds deployers of deep fakes and limits fictional works to disclosing that the content exists, the Act applies from 2 August 2026 (Art. 113), and Art. 111(4) gives providers already on the market until 2 December 2026. A game shipping AI-made fictional art is neither; the record cites only secondary summaries.
external: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=OJ:L_202401689 (accessed 2026-11-07), Art. 50(2): "outputs of the AI system are marked in a machine-readable format"
https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/article-50 (accessed 2026-11-07), Art. 50(4): "limited to disclosure of the existence of such generated or manipulated content"
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: Small: an open counsel item that the primary text already answers.
verdicts.fix: Cite Articles 50(2), 50(4), 111(4) and 113 in the record and close it as low relevance; reopen only if the game ever generates content at run time.

verdicts.claim: Every added font (such as Noto under OFL) needs a Legal register row (LR-004) first, and today the game uses only Godot's built-in Open Sans.
verdicts.what_is_true: No font file is committed at HEAD, a8bc66e2 or the live pin, project.godot sets no font, and UiText.font is null (ui/core/ui_text.gd:12), so builds use Godot's built-in Open Sans SemiBold. The register-first rule is a process margin on OFL 1.1, whose real condition is that each copy carries the notice and licence; the live About page carries the Open Sans notice and the full OFL text.
proof: git ls-files / ls-tree font count 0 at HEAD, a8bc66e2, 257a766c
external: https://openfontlicense.org/open-font-license-official-text/ (accessed 2026-11-07): "provided that each copy contains the above copyright notice and this license"
verdicts.cost_of_false_alarm: None beyond one register step per added font.
verdicts.fix: Keep; when a Noto family is added, put its OFL text on the About page and in desktop builds' notices in the same change.
